title: 1811 Prairie's bay runs its full width, from its 1888 plate
items: 1811 Prairie's bay front now runs its full 3.7 m, out to the corner where the 1888 plate draws it, so its south windows stand where the plate's do instead of half a metre north. The downpipe beside it moves past the corner onto the main front; the plate shows it running down the bay's side, which the build can't do yet.
